title: Opening and birth date
summary: Ritz opens the session in Las Vegas on September 23, 2008; Scott gives his birth date, July 17, 1925.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewer: David Ritz with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 66 pp.

My name is David Ritz. It’s September 23rd, 2008. We’re in Las Vegas, Nevada, in the beautiful home of Jeannie and Jimmy Scott. Jimmy, do want to say your name? Is that what you want? Kimery: Name, birth date, . . .
Please give your name and your birth date.
. . . I was born July 17, 1925, which makes me 83 years old this present day, but I’m grateful, because so many that I know have gone and passed on. I’m fortunate to be here.
